[[#Gloriosa|Gloriosa]] | [[Ako Mayama]] || Nancy Sherrand || TBD |} The {{nihongo|'''Rocks Pirates'''|ロックス海賊団|Rokkusu Kaizokudan}} were a powerful crew that dominated the seas forty years before the current events of the series; their strength, alongside their reckless and amoral actions led to them being considered a terrorist organization. At one point, they visited Elbaph, intending to see King Harald, and encountered Loki. Its former members would become extremely notorious and powerful individuals such as the [[Four Emperors (One Piece)|Emperors]] [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]], [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] and her later chef [[Four Emperors (One Piece)#Streusen|Streusen]], and [[Kaido (One Piece)|Kaido]], [[#Shiki|Shiki]] of the Golden Lion Pirates, [[#Buckingham Stussy|Buckingham Stussy]] of MADS, and former empress of Amazon Lily [[#Gloriosa|Gloriosa]].{{gnr|ch|957|,|1096|,|1156}} They were defeated on the island of {{nihongo|God Valley|ゴッドバレー|Goddo Barē}} by the combined efforts of [[Monkey D. Garp]] and [[#Gol D. Roger|Gol D. Roger]]. The World Economy News Paper gave Garp full credit of stopping the Rocks Pirates much to his dismay. ====Rocks D. Xebec==== {{nihongo|'''Rocks D. Xebec'''|ロックス・D・ジーベック|Rokkusu Dī Jībekku}}, born '''Davy D. Xebec''', is the captain of the Rocks Pirates, the father of [[Marshall D. Teach]], and a descendant of Davy D. Jones, former "King of the World". A violent man with incredible strength, Xebec desires to be "King of the World", gaining undying infamy after kidnapping five kings and killing an unnamed Admiral at a Reverie 56 years before the Holy Knights attacked Elbaph; the uproar he caused helped [[Harald (One Piece)|Harald]] to escape. He then hijacked a ship bound for Mariejoa laden with tribute and destroyed the Gates of Justice while fleeing; his deeds and Davy Back Fights led to him recruiting many prominent, fearsome pirates, and after four years, he raided Fullalead to serve as his base.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1155}} As a child, [[Loki (One Piece)|Loki]] idolized Xebec and approached him on Elbaph, seeking to join his crew, only for Xebec to severely injure the boy giant to discourage him from ever joining.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1145}} Xebec's threat grew to a point where the World Government was willing to accept Elbaph on the condition Harald kills him.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1157}} Xebec and Harald later fought to a draw and Xebec gave up on recruiting Harald.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1158}} Imu later possessed Xebec and transformed him into a demon to have him attack his family.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1163}} Rocks was killed by the World Government some time later. The Rocks Pirates break up, with their members' reputation being tarnished to have been untrustworthy.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1096|,|1159|,|1165}} Xebec was gradually erased from history and forgotten by the public by World Government propaganda, to the point only Marines who were present back then knew of his existence.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|957}} Rocks D. Xebec is voiced by Shinshū Fuji in the original Japanese version. ====Shiki==== {{nihongo|'''Shiki'''|シキ}}, also known as {{nihongo|'''Shiki the Golden Lion'''|金獅子のシキ|Kinjishi no Shiki}}, is a mobster and former member of the Rocks Pirates with sword-like prosthetic for feet. A prominent member of the crew, he is from the Yano Country and was present at the God Valley incident.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1165}} Shiki later formed the [[Golden Lion Pirates]] and also being served by an army of mutant animals. After escaping from Impel Down at the time the first to do so, he unsuccessfully attempted to recruit Roger for his dreams of world domination.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|0|,|1096}} Outside of being the first pirate to escape from Impel Down, Shiki later consumed the Float-Float Fruit which enables him to make himself and any object float. He developed his own plans for decades since Roger's death only to make the fatal mistake of forcibly recruiting Nami and earning a humiliating defeat by [[Monkey D. Luffy]] by the time of the film ''[[One Piece Film: Strong World]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbr.com/one-piece-every-movie-villain-ranked/ |title=One Piece: Every Movie Villain, Ranked |author=Sean Cubillas |date=November 9, 2020 |website=[[Comic Book Resources]]}} Shiki is voiced by Naoto Takenata in the original Japanese version and by [[Scott McNeil]] in the Funimation dub. ====Buckingham Stussy==== {{nihongo|'''Buckingham Stussy'''|バッキンガム・ステューシー|Bakkingamu Sutyūshī}}, also known as {{nihongo|"'''Miss Buckin'''"|ミス・バッキン|Misu Bakkin}}, is the mother of [[#Edward Weevil|Edward Weevil]]. She is a former member of the Rocks Pirates, a former member of MADS and the self-proclaimed lover of [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]. While a competent combatant to have been recruited by [[#Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks D. Xebec]], she contributed next to nothing at MADS outside of having a clone of her named [[World Government (One Piece)#Stussy|Stussy]] be produced. Buckingham Stussy is voiced by [[Reiko Suzuki]] in the original Japanese version and by [[Erica Schroeder]] in the Funimation dub. ====Captain John==== {{nihongo|'''Captain John'''|ジョン|Jon}} is a former member of the Rocks Pirates. A greedy and loathsome drunkard who is nevertheless a competent combatant, he was present during the God Valley incident and was a previous consumer of the Magnet-Magnet Fruit. Afterwards, John formed his own crew and collecting a significant amount of treasure. After he was killed by his crew for his greed, John's corpse was later stolen from his grave by [[#Gecko Moria|Gecko Moria]] and made into a General Zombie.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|451|,|1096}} His armband, which was the key to finding his treasure, was taken by Luffy after Moria was defeated{{Graphic novel reference|ch|486}} and later traded to [[Buggy the Clown|Buggy]] for his assistance in Impel Down.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|527}} John is voiced by [[Hiroshi Okamoto]] in the original Japanese version and by Ken Marmon in the Funimation dub. ====Ganzui==== {{Nihongo|'''Ganzui'''|ガンズイ}} is a smuggler by trade of great size who was the original consumer of the Bomb-Bomb Fruit. He is involved in the God Valley Incident. Ganzui dies sometime after the God Valley Incident. Ganzui's corpse was stolen by [[#Gecko Moria|Gecko Moria]] and made into a General Zombie.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|451|,|1096|,|1155}} ====Gill Bastar==== {{Nihongo|'''Gill Bastar'''|ギル・バスター|Giru Basutā}} is a skilled sharpshooter and former member of the Rocks Pirates who was a previous consumer of the Hollow-Hollow Fruit. He gains an extra pair of arms during his tenure on the crew to improve his strength before being involved in the God Valley incident.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1165}} He dies sometime after the incident with his corpse later stolen by [[#Gecko Moria|Gecko Moria]] and made into a General Zombie. Bastar's creation predates ''One Piece'', having debuted in 1992 in Eiichiro Oda's first one-shot manga ''[[Wanted! Eiichiro Oda Before One Piece#Wanted! (1992)|Wanted!]]'', where a younger Bastar without his extra arms serves as the protagonist.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|451|,|1096}}{{Cite book |last=Oda |first=Eiichiro |title=One Piece Volume 112 |date=July 4, 2025 |publisher=[[Shueisha]]}} ====Wang Zhi==== {{Nihongo|'''Wang Zhi'''|王直|Ōchoku}} is a [[guru]] and former member of the Rocks Pirates. During the rescue mission of Shakuyaku, Wang Zhi stayed behind on Hachinosu.{{graphic novel reference|ch|1160}} After the God Valley incident, he captured Fullalead, his former crew's base, where he resided until he is defeated with the combined forces of [[Marshall D. Teach]] and [[Koby (One Piece)|Koby]], with Teach taking control of the island like his father.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1096|,|1155}} ====Other Rocks Pirates==== * {{Nihongo|'''Don Marlon'''|マーロン|Māron}}: A [[gangster]] from the West Blue who wears a black fedora and smokes a cigar. He is killed during a confrontation where Shakuyaku is kidnapped.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1155|,|1159}} * {{Nihongo|'''Kyo'''|兇|Kyō}}: A mobster and rival of Shiki who was later known as Silver Axe.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1156}} * {{Nihongo|'''Barbell'''|バーベル|Bāberu}}: A [[catfish]] Fish-Man who was present at the God Valley incident.{{Graphic novel reference|ch|1096|,|1156}} ==Anime-exclusive pirates== There are several pirate and pirate crews exclusive of [[Toei Animation]]'s [[One Piece (1999 TV series)|anime series]]: ===Barbar Pirates=== The '''Barbar Pirates''' are sand pirates of the [[Kingdom of Alabasta]]: * {{nihongo|'''Barbarossa'''|バルバロッサ|Barubarossa}}: The captain of the Barbar Pirates. After a bad encounter with Luffy and his friends after meeting them, he quickly becomes friends with them when he sees that they are pirates like him.{{cite episode |series=One Piece |series-link=One Piece (1999 TV series) |title=Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters that Live in the Scorching Land! |episode-link=One Piece season 4#ep97 |season=4 |number=5 |date=January 20, 2002 |network=[[Fuji Television]]}} Barbarossa is voiced by [[Chō]] in the original Japanese version, [[David Brimmer]] in the 4Kids dub, and by [[Jeremy Inman]] in the Funimation dub. * {{nihongo|'''Rasa'''|ラサ}}: The navigator of the Barbar Pirates. In the past, Rasa lived in a small oasis village called Melias that's located in Yuba before it was buried in sand and abandoned. After which, she lost faith in the Nefertari family to help the kingdom prosper. Rasa is voiced by [[Miki Nagasawa]] in the original Japanese version, [[Caren Lyn Tackett]] in the 4Kids dub, and by [[Trina Nishimura]] in the Funimation dub. * {{nihongo|'''Zaba'''|ザバ}}: A member of the Barbar pirates. He thinks more logically and is shown more calmer than many of his crewmates. Zaba is voiced by [[Shinichiro Ohta]] in the original Japanese version and by [[Phil Parsons (voice actor)|Phil Parsons]] in the Funimation dub. ===Amigo Pirates=== The '''Amigo Pirates''' are a crew allied with [[#Shiki|Shiki]] who tried to attack the [[List of One Piece characters#Little East Blue|Little East Blue]]. * {{nihongo|'''Largo'''|ラルゴ|Rarugo}}: The captain of the Amigo Pirates, an ally of Shiki, and the main antagonist of the anime-exclusive [[One Piece season 13#Little East Blue|Little East Blue arc]]. He ate the Net-Net Fruit which enables him to create nets out of a sticky material. Llargo is voiced by [[Wataru Takagi]] in the original Japanese version and by [[Leraldo Anzaldua]] in the Funimation dub. * {{nihongo|'''Corto'''|コルト|Koruto}}: The brother of Largo and a member of the Amigo Pirates. He dresses like a luchador. Corto is voiced by [[Hisao Egawa]] in the original Japanese version and by [[Ricco Fajardo]] in the Funimation dub. ===Breed=== {{nihongo|'''Breed'''|ブリード|Burīdo}} is the former captain of the Breed Pirates and the main antagonist of the anime-exclusive [[One Piece season 16#Caesar Retrieval|Caesar Retrieval arc]]. He ate the Pet-Pet Fruit, which enables him to produce a green gel that can be used to make collars that control whoever they are placed on. Breed's crew engineered a mutiny, which led to Breed having to form a new crew by enslaving the Sea Animal Pirates led by a Kung-Fu Dugong. Breed planned to use the captive Caesar Clown to make SMILE Fruits for him by having him abducted from the Straw Hat Pirates' ship following the departure from Dressrosa.
